now.summary: Home loading, saved covers, a smarter buffer for skipping and weak connections, the slow-internet note and the Skip Intro hover are done and being tested.

items.title: Skipping forward and back is not instant
items.line: A bigger, smarter video buffer.
items.detail: The buffer is worked out each time a video starts, from your free memory and the line. Skipping inside it is instant, forward and back. A jump far outside it, like half an hour ahead, still has to fetch from the server.

items.title: Videos stall on a weak connection
items.line: More is kept ahead of you on a slow line.
items.detail: When the line is slow or drops packets, a larger share of the buffer goes to what is coming up, so short drops no longer stop the picture.

items.title: Home stays blank on a slow connection
items.line: Home says what it waits for and retries by itself.
items.detail: A loading message, then "Still connecting", and when the server does not answer a countdown with a Try now button. A steadier connection to the server underneath.

items.title: Covers load slowly on weak internet
items.line: Locked cover cache and lighter covers on a slow line.
items.detail: Covers are saved on your PC (scrambled, only Vyneo can open them), replaced covers are deleted, and smaller ones are asked for while the line is slow.

items.title: No sign when the internet is slow
items.line: A note under your profile says so.
items.detail: "Slow internet, loading lighter covers", then "Connection is back" in green when it recovers.

items.title: Skip Intro and Skip Recap go black on hover
items.line: The button keeps its light look under the pointer.

items.title: Watch Together drifts between two players
items.line: Needs a test with two real players.
items.detail: The heartbeat sync is in, but long-session drift is not confirmed. If you see two people slowly falling out of step, use I have this too and say how long you had been watching.

items.title: Different Vyneo versions in Watch Together
items.line: A warning is shown, never a block.
items.detail: If the other person is on another version, the invite says so and you can still go ahead.

items.title: Discover trailer cut off its subtitles
items.line: The banner is taller.

items.title: Subtitle list crash in the player
items.line: Opening Settings in the video no longer closes Vyneo.
items.detail: It happened when a video had several subtitle tracks in the same language.

items.title: Top bar pill stuck off its tab
items.line: It stays on its tab after a resize.

items.title: Leaving a Watch Together video
items.line: Back, the mouse back button or Esc leaves the party at once.
items.detail: The host's next update no longer pulls you back in.

items.title: Joining someone who is a guest
items.line: The request goes to the host.

items.title: Top bar heart sat off line
items.line: It sits level with the search button.

items.title: Search left a brighter band at the top
items.line: The top bar dims together with the page.

items.title: Two quiet errors on every start
items.line: No longer logged when Jellyseerr is not set up.

items.title: Picture subtitles (PGS) in the wrong place
items.line: They sit right when the picture is fitted.

items.title: Skip Intro landed on the wrong scene
items.line: It finds the real opening when a file has Intro and OP chapters.

items.title: Two cards said Waiting on the server
items.line: Only one says it now.

items.title: Badges looked different at start
items.line: They look the same before and after syncing.

items.title: Profile picture cut off in the top bar
items.line: It shows whole.

items.title: Skip Intro landed before the song
items.line: A chapter named OP or Opening wins over a plain Intro.

items.title: Space bar paused for guests
items.line: Only people the host gave control to can pause.

items.title: Title card said the server was asleep
items.line: It no longer says so when the server is fine.

items.title: Window could be made too small
items.line: The top bar and cards are no longer cut off.

items.title: No Watch Together on Android TV
items.line: TV is for the couch with family.
items.detail: Watch Together is for phones, tablets and PCs.

items.title: Invites only arrive while the app is open
items.line: On purpose, to keep Vyneo light.
